scope: Read-only feasibility assessment. No schedule implemented or launched; no existing source modified and no certificate contents read.
requirements: Prove the original scheduler and its complete child process group quiescent before parallel reservations. Preserve original attempts and explicitly record transition.
Account retained v1 and v2 owned files under one unchanged shared cap. A new directory does not reset the budget.
Reserve both stricter per-mutant ceilings atomically and enforce each while bytes are written.
Use coordinator and per-generation leases; stale leases must not permit overlapping live owners.
Measure combined RSS of both process groups against unchanged12GiB combined allowance and preserve per-command6GiB caps.
Failed or unclassified retained payloads continue consuming capacity and block admission when necessary.
Review exact provenance adapter/checker changes: current accepted checker pins v1 paths and sources. Reusing completed v1 evidence must remain explicit and cannot duplicate actual invocations.
Treat contention timeouts as failures; no automatic cap increase or retries.
